_readme: Evidence for Z-Image Turbo, CineBraid's cheap-and-local image candidate.
The important discipline here is family versus checkpoint, the same one MiniMax H3
forced. The Z-Image family contains at least four distinct models and they are not
interchangeable: Z-Image-Turbo generates, Z-Image-Edit edits. Recording 'Z-Image can
edit' would put an editing control on a screen that the distilled checkpoint cannot

sources.note: The official ComfyUI template, read during Phase 1 and unchanged.

releasedCheckpoints.note: A DIFFERENT model. Not encoded; CineBraid has no capability record for it.

capabilities.note: Stated as fitting comfortably within 16GB, with CPU offloading available below that.

capabilities.claim: Bilingual text rendering, Chinese and English.
Seed and batch size are caller arguments.
capabilities.note: KSampler(seed) and EmptySD3LatentImage(batch_size) in the official template.

capabilities.claim: LoRA and ControlNet are wired in the official template.

notEstablished.status: the card demonstrates 1024x1024 and publishes no ceiling
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: constraints.resolutions is null, meaning unrestricted rather than 1024-only.
promptPolicy.state is not-established. No pack ships for this family and no prompting rules are invented.

notEstablished.status: not investigated - the reason to carry this model is that it runs locally
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: Only the comfy-local surface records an offering.

positions.scope: the card's own model-zoo diversity column for the Turbo variant

conflicts.resolution: Both are the vendor's. Recorded as a caveat on the catalogue entry rather than resolved - a distilled speed model trading diversity for latency is exactly what it is for.
